question: Which observances and which sixteenfold set are located in the principle of the person?
premises: Service, purity, contentment, and straightness are among the ten declared qualities.
These ten are located in the principle of the person.
A sixteenfold set ending with smell is also situated there.
inference: The principle of the person contains both the ten declared observances and a sixteenfold set extending to smell.
uncertainties: The full list of all ten qualities is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: In the principle of the person are the ten declared qualities, including service, purity, contentment, and straightness. There too is situated a sixteenfold set ending with smell.
